description: This file defines an Android Fragment class 'ClippingBasicFragment' that demonstrates clipping a View using an Outline. It handles view outline provisioning, toggling clip states via a button, and changing displayed text upon clicks.

classes.name: ClippingBasicFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that demonstrates how to clip a View using an Outline, with toggle and text change functionalities.

classes.name: ClippingBasicFragment.ClipOutlineProvider
classes.description: A custom ViewOutlineProvider that clips the view with a rounded rect inset by 10%.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes resources, including the outline provider and sample texts.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up click listeners for toggling clipping and changing text, initializes UI elements.

methods.name: changeText
methods.description: Changes the TextView's text based on the click count, cycling through a string array.

methods.name: ClippingBasicFragment.ClipOutlineProvider.getOutline
methods.description: Defines the outline as a rounded rectangle inset by 10% of the dimensions.
